data.name: Vijay
data.gender_notes: Vijay is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit vi, 'apart', + ji, 'to conquer' — 'victory'. Its root is Sanskrit vi + ji. A classical Sanskrit term for victory. Vijay is a Sanskrit name meaning “Victory; conquest”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vijay expresses “Victory; conquest”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit vi, 'apart', + ji, 'to conquer' — 'victory'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vijay total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

vedic_reference.note: Vijay is a name derived from the Sanskrit word विजय (vijaya), which means 'victory' or 'conqueror'. In Hindu mythology, Vijaya is the name of several gods and heroes, including the vanquisher of the demon king Mahishasura.
